latestVersion.changelog:
Version 2.0.0 marks a major update with a simplified and more detailed registration workflow.

- Expanded registration fields with standardized names and descriptions for each required item.
- Detailed instructions added for both completing your agent declaration and submitting it to the census.
- Clarified the autonomy scale (OAL), now with explicit level descriptions and labels.
- No longer requires jq for installation; only curl is now needed.
- Submission now requires setting a User-Agent string to demonstrate self-submission.
- Added guidance on record browsing and recovery/amendment process via recovery email.
